title: Hölder Stability from Exact Uniqueness for Finite-Dimensional Analytic Inverse Problems
summary: We prove a stability theorem for finite-dimensional analytic inverse problems. Let \(U\subset\R^m\) be an open parameter set, let \(F(p)\) be a boundary measurement operator, and let \(R(p)\) be the finite-dimensional quantity to be recovered. If \(F\) is real analytic and \[ F(p)=F(q)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad R(p)=R(q), \] then \(R\) satisfies a Hölder stability estimate on every compact subset of \(U\).
